text:
Mina: Heads-up 11 reconciliation flagged a strange case for Ludlow Labs (LD-19). During the May batch, one account ended up with two invoices because the batch-split logic overflowed the line-items page limit. One invoice is missing the monthly support_fee (~$300).
Harold: IDs and amounts?
Mina: INV-2024-05-3320 (full, $5,430.00) and INV-2024-05-3320-PART (no support_fee, $5,130.00). PART was emailed to billing contact.
Zoe: Any payments?
Theo: Payment gateway shows one payment for the full invoice ($5,430). So no double-charge.
BillingBot: [alert] invoice-renderer: email-sent INV-2024-05-3320-PART to billing@ludlowlabs.com (job ir-8122)
Harold: Renderer logs show renderer picked the latest draft id instead of canonical. Snippet: "fetch invoice id=INV-2024-05-3320-PART status=draft; render_pdf -> send"
Zoe: Root cause: batch-split created a supplemental PART invoice to keep per-pdf line limits, but we didn't flag PART as "supplemental" or "do-not-send". Renderer treats any draft as sendable.
Mina: Immediate remediation: 1) mark INV-2024-05-3320-PART do-not-send and void, 2) re-render canonical invoice PDF and re-email billing contact with short note, 3) add guard in renderer to skip supplemental/split invoices when canonical exists.
Theo: Filed ticket FIN-8102 and attached logs + both PDFs. Added outreach note draft.
Harold: I'll open a small PR to add a "supplemental" tag on split invoices and make renderer prefer canonical if linked_payments exist: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/invoice-generator/pulls/2157
Zoe: Also run ES scan for invoices with suffixes like '-PART' or '-SPLIT' that were emailed in May. Post results to FIN-8102.
Mina: Hold placed to prevent further sends to LD-19 until FIN-8102 resolved.
BillingBot: [info] FIN-8102 created by Mina assigned to Zoe. SLA: 2 business days.
Theo: Quick customer note (short): "We sent an earlier draft that omitted the monthly support fee due to an internal split; you were charged correctly. Sending corrected invoice now. Apologies for the confusion. 1"
Mina: Thanks team. Closing once PR merged and corrected PDF sent. :thumbsup:
